text: Looking for a motion designer, who makes ads people actually stop for?
Hi. I'm [Tahir](/tˈɑhiɹ/). [Adewale](/ɑdˈɛwɑlɛ/). [Oyewole](/ojˈɛwolɛ/). Motion designer, and founder of F.D.A.C.
I'm based in Nigeria, and I work with brands all over the world.
I create motion graphics videos for ads. Videos that grab attention, and make people act.
Motion graphics explain complex ideas. They advertise your product. They build your brand, tell your story, educate your audience, and turn data into something people remember.
Movement catches the eye. In a world of endless scrolling, motion makes your message impossible to ignore.
Like this launch ad for F.D.A.C, a community helping young people learn new skills. I turned their mission into a movement.
Focus. Discipline. And consistency. It's how I run my own work, and how I'll handle yours.
Your brand deserves to be seen. Let's put it in motion. Chat with me on WhatsApp, today.
